title: DECISION: SEARCH unreachable!() in dispatch() with explicit panic message documents invariant
description: dispatch.rs Command::Search arm uses unreachable!() with an explicit message explaining the lifecycle interception invariant. This is the correct approach — a future contributor who moves SEARCH handling will get a clear panic message rather than a silent wrong-response. Do not replace this with a fallback 503 response, which would silently hide the broken invariant.
